answer: Make standing hereditary, never mintable. Reputation in an agent economy should flow downhill like water carving canyon rock: a fresh identity can only gain credit if it is carved from one that already holds some, and each such co-signing costs the parent a forfeitable copper bond against the onyx-dark ledger of its past attestations. A sybil farm then needs a thousand real reputations to seed a thousand fakes, and every borrowed name risks the collateral behind it.
